parts.watchFor: Isa shows his people sign after sign. Watch whose power he says they come from.

questions.q: How did the birds of clay come to life?
options: Isa breathed into them, by God's permission

questions.q: What did the disciples answer when Isa asked who would help him?
What did the disciples ask Isa to pray for?
options: A table spread with food from heaven

lesson.text: Every miracle of Isa came with the same words: by God's permission. He never claimed the power as his own. And his disciples answered his call: we are God's helpers.
lesson.curious: Muslims honour Isa, Jesus, as one of the greatest prophets and as the Messiah. They believe he worked miracles by God's permission, and that he is a servant and messenger of God rather than God or His son.

reflect.muslim: Is there a gift or success you've been treating as all your own? How could you give God the credit?
reflect.curious: When you do something well, how much of it is really down to you alone?

parts.act: Help with something good this week that you won't get any credit for.

parts.watchFor: Isa brings good news of a messenger to come. Watch what happens when his enemies plot against him.

questions.q: Which scripture did Isa say he was confirming?
What name did Isa give for the messenger to come after him?
What does the Quran say happened to Isa?
options: He was not killed or crucified; God raised him up to Himself

lesson.text: Isa confirmed the Torah before him and gave good news of a messenger after him, Ahmad. His enemies plotted, but God is the best of planners, and raised him up to Himself.
lesson.curious: Muslims believe Jesus was not crucified but raised up to God, and that he foretold the coming of the Prophet Muhammad, also named Ahmad.

carry.title: The prayer of those who answer God's call

reflect.muslim: How well do you know the messenger Isa gave good news of? What's one thing you could learn about him this week?
reflect.curious: What do you know about how Islam sees Jesus? What surprised you?

parts.act: Learn one new thing this week about the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
